purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

candidate.base: studio-z/r63 (gameplay/bug-list-1 + main bc77a0b r62) with the Studio Z4 session pointer

added: // Studio Z4: one shared pointer to the pair's current session, so the rival's phone joins without a typed code.
// Only the two accounts of the live paired rivalry read it; only a session's own host may point it at that open or
// active session, with the session's own expiry and a server write time. It is never listed or deleted.
hunks.why: Studio Z4 helpers: the pair's session pointer may only be written by the session's own host, for an open or active session of the live paired rivalry, with that session's expiry and a server write time.

added: allow get: if offerId == "current" && activeActor() && activePairedRivalry(rivalryId) && currentlyEntitled(rivalryId);
allow create, update: if validSessionOfferWrite(rivalryId, offerId);
hunks.why: Studio Z4 match: the two paired accounts get the single 'current' pointer; the host creates or moves it; it is never listed or deleted.
